name: dhvani
description: Local AI dubbing studio. ElevenLabs for transcription, word-accurate subtitle timestamps and voice; Gemini for translation.

scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node server/index.js
scripts.test: node --test services/speechTiming.test.ts server/env.test.js server/lib/srt.test.js server/lib/scriptAlign.test.js server/lib/ttsText.test.js server/lib/audioJoin.test.js server/lib/syncDub.test.js server/lib/dubTakes.test.js server/lib/syncEdit.test.js server/lib/speakerMix.test.js server/lib/syncPreview.test.js server/lib/syncFit.test.js server/lib/syncRewrite.test.js server/lib/deliveryCues.test.js server/lib/sourceCues.test.js server/lib/media.test.js server/lib/pipeline.test.js server/providers/gemini/threeStepTranslation.test.js server/providers/elevenlabs/dubProgress.test.js server/providers/cartesia/cartesia.test.js server/providers/llmGateway/client.test.js server/providers/llmGateway/url.test.js server/providers/llmGateway/discovery.test.js services/scriptShare.test.ts services/cueEdit.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.desktop: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --win zip portable --publish never
